query: Anyways, how do I file an FIR online in TN?
reference_answer:
Filing an FIR Online in Tamil Nadu:
Yes, you can file an e-FIR for certain crimes like theft, loss of documents, and cybercrime through the Tamil Nadu Police website or the Citizen Portal.
answer: To file an FIR online in Tamil Nadu (TN), visit the TN Police website, fill out the FIR form, and submit it online. [Document 1]
